If it doesn't work out for me, what are my options?
If something on By Rotation “doesn’t work out,” your options depend on what’s gone wrong:
Item doesn’t fit / misrepresented: Refunds are up to the lender’s policy and, if granted, are app credit only, not cash. If it was misrepresented, report the issue and raise a refund request in‑app.
Want to use money differently: You can use your lending earnings to pay for rentals, or withdraw them to your bank (minimum balance required; processed via Stripe in ~3 working days).
Sale regret: All resales are final—no refunds once a sale goes through.
Tax / high earnings concerns: If you earn over the HMRC threshold or 30+ transactions, we must report certain details; only your profits may be taxable.
Off‑app deals gone wrong: Payments or agreements made outside the app aren’t protected and we generally can’t help recover them.
Need a break: You can step back from lending without losing all progress, and your lender tier is reviewed quarterly on a rolling 12‑month window.
Done with the platform: You can delete your account by emailing us from your registered email.
These are the main routes available if things don’t go as planned, based only on the policies above.

We can’t see your exact booking total, but here’s how it works based on our process:

Total charged: For rentals, your card is only fully charged once the lender accepts and the rental goes ahead.
When money moves:
If the rental is declined/expired/cancelled, the hold is released or refunded (can take up to 8 working days, depending on your bank).
If the rental is completed, payment is then sent on to the lender and appears in their balance. Payouts to a lender’s bank typically land within 3 working days after withdrawal, though Stripe’s processing for some payments and invoices can take 8–10 working days.

If you’re waiting on a refund or payout, the arrival time will be within those windows depending on whether you’re the renter (refund) or lender (payout).
